This document governs the use of the ThingTracker mobile application and explains how user data and privacy are handled. By downloading, installing, or using the app, you agree to the terms below. If you do not agree with these terms, you have the freedom and option to uninstall the app at any time.

1. Use of the App and Provision As-Is
The ThingTracker app is provided free of charge, as is, and as available, without explicit or implicit warranties of any kind.

The developer does not guarantee that the app will function uninterrupted, error-free, or meet all individual user requirements.

2. Data Storage, JSON Backup and Limitation of Liability
100%% Local Storage & JSON Backup: All data entered into the app is saved locally on your device in the internal database (Room). The app provides an option to export and import data as a JSON file (manual backup).

No Absolute Guarantees: Since the app does not use external servers or automatic cloud synchronization, the user is solely responsible for creating and safely storing JSON backups. Uninstalling the app, losing the phone, or backup file corruption without a valid copy may result in permanent data loss.

Disclaimer of Liability: The developer (N3looG) bears no liability for data loss, material damage, or any other direct or indirect damages resulting from the use or inability to use the app.

3. Data Privacy (Privacy Policy)
No collection of personal data: The developer does not collect, store on external servers, process, or sell any personal information entered by you within the app.

Third-party advertising services (Google AdMob): To keep the app free, ThingTracker integrates the third-party advertising network Google AdMob.

The Google AdMob service may collect and use anonymous device identifiers (e.g., Advertising ID) for displaying, measuring, and personalizing ads (banner / rewarded ads).

For full details on how Google processes advertising data, you can consult Google's Privacy Policy.

4. Requested Permissions
Notifications and Alarms (Notifications / System Alarm): The app requests permission to send on-screen notifications solely to send you reminders at the date and time set by you for a borrowed item.

These notifications work completely offline, locally on your phone. You can disable the permission anytime from Android system settings, but this will stop alerts from functioning.

5. Intellectual Property Rights
Source code, interface design, logo, graphics, and the ThingTracker trademark belong exclusively to the developer (N3looG).

Decompilation, reverse engineering, modification, or redistribution of the app without the developer's written consent is prohibited.

6. Modifications and Termination of Use
The developer reserves the right to update this document at any time.

You can stop using the app and remove all associated data simply by uninstalling the app from your device.

7. Contact
For any questions or requests regarding this policy, you can contact me through the support option provided on the app page in the Google Play Store.

Welcome to ThingTracker!

1. Adding an Item:
Tap the green '+' button at the bottom right. Choose whether you lent or borrowed the item, enter the title, pick the contact directly from your phone book, and set a return due date.

2. Search & Filtering:
Use the search bar at the top to instantly find any item or person. Tap the top stat boxes (Lent, Borrowed, Overdue) to filter lists immediately.

3. Quick Call:
Tap the phone icon on any card to call the borrower or lender instantly.

4. Returning & Deleting:
Tap the green checkmark to mark an item as returned (with safety confirmation). Tap the red trash icon to permanently delete an item.

5. Settings & Language:
Use the bottom navigation to access Settings to change language, read Terms & Privacy Policy, or access User Manual.

6. Backup & Restore:
Go to Settings to export your data as a secure JSON file or import a backup when switching to a new phone.
